title: Second Suspected Pakistani Drone Tracked Along LoC in Poonch's Mendhar Sector
detail: A suspected Pakistani UAV was detected around 8:05 PM on August 28, 2026, hovering over the general area of Behrooti village, Balakote area, in the Mendhar sector of Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district — within the operational area of responsibility of the Indian Army's 22 Jammu and Kashmir Rifles. Troops tracked the drone as it manoeuvred toward the Mangalnar-Dabrote axis near the border before returning to Pakistan. The Army placed the forward sector under tight aerial and ground surveillance and launched a search operation at first light on August 29 to check for any dropped contraband or arms; the operation remained underway with no recoveries reported. The sighting follows a separate drone intrusion and foiled infiltration bid in Rajouri's Nowshera sector the previous night, keeping the LoC on heightened alert.

media.caption: Security forces launch a search operation along the LoC in Poonch after a suspected Pakistani drone sighting, August 29, 2026

title: 25 Pakistani Nationals, Including Fishermen, Released From Indian Jails and Repatriated via Wagah
detail: Twenty-five Pakistani nationals — including fishermen from Karachi and Thatta who had completed prison terms after straying into Indian waters — were released from Indian jails and repatriated to Pakistan through the Wagah-Attari border on August 29, 2026. The group crossed in the afternoon after completing immigration and administrative formalities and were handed over to Pakistani authorities, with Pakistan High Commission officials present to facilitate the process. The release forms part of prisoner lists exchanged between the two countries on July 1, 2026 under the bilateral consular access arrangement, which listed 386 civilian prisoners and 53 fishermen in Indian custody; Pakistani officials renewed calls for the release of the roughly 177 Pakistani detainees still held in India. The fishermen were received by the Pakistan Fishermen's Cooperative Society on arrival.

media.caption: Released Pakistani nationals cross into Pakistan at the Wagah border after completing prison terms in India, August 29, 2026
